description: Generate registration.php, etc/module.xml and composer.json for a new Adobe Commerce module (Vendor_Module), adapted from the official docs. Returns the files (path and content) for the caller to write; the server never writes to disk. Use it when starting a module.

basePath.description: Module directory relative to the Commerce root (default "app/code/<Vendor>/<Module>")

module.description: Module name as Vendor_Module (e.g. "Acme_Reviews"), as registered in registration.php

php.description: PHP constraint for composer.json require (e.g. "~8.3.0||~8.4.0"). Omitted when not given.

sequence.description: Modules that must load before this one, for <sequence> in module.xml (e.g. ["Magento_Catalog"])

name: scaffold-module

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the Commerce root

source.description: Documentation page the template was adapted from

title: Scaffold an Adobe Commerce module
